_meta.rule: A field is filled only from an authorized first-party report (Amazon Associates reports, or our own analytics endpoint once it exists). Nothing is estimated, extrapolated or forecast. No conversion score or revenue projection appears on this site.
_meta.provenance_rule: Every future row must carry: the report it came from, the report period, the date the report was pulled, and who pulled it. A row without a provenance trail is invalid.
_meta.why_empty: No analytics endpoint is live (FLG-006) and no Associates report has been pulled (FLG-010).

definitions.eligible_session: A session in which the page rendered and the disclosure strip entered the viewport at least once. Establishes that the reader had the opportunity to see the material connection.
definitions.outbound_click: A click on a link carrying rel="sponsored" that resolves to an amazon.com destination.
definitions.reported_order: A shipped order as counted in an Amazon Associates report for this tag. Not a page view, not an add-to-cart, not our own estimate.
definitions.channel: The referral source: organic, direct, rss, social, or unknown.
definitions.source: The page path the session started on.

totals.note: Null means not measured. It does not mean zero.
